body: i think this reopens the thing the removed comment was guarding against. if the user picked biometric only, this ORs in DEVICE_CREDENTIAL anyway, so a fingerprint lockout on a Samsung with face_screen_lock=1 lets the app open with the PIN. and when the mask already includes credential the loop adds it on its own. could we drop the OR and just keep `requested` here, or gate it on methods containing METHOD_CREDENTIAL?

checked this on a Pixel 4 XL with Magisk 30.7 and none of these paths exist. su is at /debug_ramdisk/su and /product/bin/su, and /data/adb/magisk/su isn't readable from the app so File.exists() says false. KernelSU and APatch don't ship an su file at all. so on those setups this returns false and face detection through dumpsys just stops working. the old code resolved su via PATH which is why it worked. i'd put a timeout on RootShell.exec instead, that handles the 15s hang everywhere

i don't think this branch can succeed from the app process. isHardwareDetected, getEnrolledFaces and hasEnrolledTemplates all need USE_BIOMETRIC_INTERNAL or MANAGE_BIOMETRIC and FaceService enforces that server side, we only hold USE_BIOMETRIC. so this throws, readFaceCount returns null, and with fallbackSuccessEnrolled off for dual sensor devices a Pixel with face enrolled now shows Not enrolled. did you get a non-null count from this on any device?
given the above, i'd keep the weak status fallback on for face until we have a count source that actually works on aosp, otherwise dual sensor pixels regress

createPackageContextAsUser is @hide @SystemApi and needs INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS, which we can't hold. for user 10 it throws inside runCatching and nothing gets added, so prune still drops the work profile overrides. for user 0 it duplicates the getInstalledApplications block right below. if we want this, LauncherApps is the only cross profile surface available to us, so non-launcher apps in the profile may just be out of reach without help from the hook side

publicVersion has to stay nulled i'm afraid. sysui renders it on the lock screen instead of the redacted title and text, so with lock screen set to sensitive content when unlocked the sender name from a locked messaging app still shows while the app is locked

```suggestion
    notification.headsUpContentView = null
    notification.publicVersion = null
```

this one worries me a bit. ActivityStarter.executeRequest already captured userId, callingPackage and realCallingUid from the signal launch (module app, user 0) before intercept runs, and resumeInPlace only rewrites mIntent, mCallingUid and mUserId. so for a work profile target isPermissionsReviewRequired runs as user 0 and the ActivityRecord is attributed to the module package instead of the original caller. the startActivityAsUser replay was there for exactly this and 1f9f29aa just fixed work profile prompts on that path. the PR mentions testing on a personal user Xiaomi, did you get a chance to try a work profile app? if not i'd keep the isSystemHandler gate for now

small thing, this runs createPackageContext plus two getIdentifier lookups inside the NMS enqueue path for every redacted notification and the result never changes. the module's R ids are already valid for pkgCtx, so pkgCtx.getString(R.string.notification_redacted_title) in a lazy val would do it and also stops depending on the resource shrinker keeping those names

moving the transact calls off the main thread makes sense. one thing though, this executor is per instance and never shut down, and we create one instance per prompt, so each unlock leaves a non daemon thread behind until the finalizer gets to it. a single shared executor at top level, or shutdown() after the result, would avoid that

replied only becomes true in onResult, which already does this teardown, so this copy never runs. the same four lines are now in four places, maybe a private stopMiuiFace() and call it from onResult, the negative button and the lockout retry?
